mapper.select: WITH facts AS ( SELECT p.attempt_id,p.result_kind, MAX(b.reported) FILTER (WHERE b.dimension='INPUT_TOKENS') AS input_tokens, MAX(b.reported) FILTER (WHERE b.dimension='OUTPUT_TOKENS') AS output_tokens, MAX(b.reported) FILTER (WHERE b.dimension='TOTAL_TOKENS') AS total_tokens FROM agent_runtime_execution_attempts p JOIN agent_runtime_execution_actions a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.action_id=p.action_id AND a.run_id=p.run_id LEFT JOIN agent_runtime_budget_attempt_amounts b ON b.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND b.attempt_id=p.attempt_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.run_id=#{run} AND a.kind='MODEL' GROUP BY p.attempt_id,p.result_kind ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(total_tokens,COALESCE(input_tokens,0)+COALESCE(output_tokens,0))),0) AS reported_tokens, COALESCE(min(input_tokens IS NOT NULL AND output_tokens IS NOT NULL AND result_kind IS NOT NULL AND result_kind IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED')),true) AS complete FROM facts

SELECT CASE WHEN lease_claim_id IS NOT NULL AND (lease_until_second,lease_until_nano)>(next_due_second,next_due_nano) THEN lease_until_second ELSE next_due_second END AS second, CASE WHEN lease_claim_id IS NOT NULL AND (lease_until_second,lease_until_nano)>(next_due_second,next_due_nano) THEN lease_until_nano ELSE next_due_nano END AS nano FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND phase IN ('READY','AWAITING_RESULT') AND NOT cancelled AND next_due_second IS NOT NULL ORDER BY second,nano,run_id LIMIT 1

WITH scope AS (SELECT run_id FROM agent_runtime_execution_runs WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session}), totals AS ( SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM scope) AS run_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_runtime_execution_events e JOIN scope r ON r.run_id=e.run_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND e.session_id=#{session} AND e.event_id=desktop_finished_event_id(r.run_id) AND CASE json_type(e.canonical_json,'$.text') WHEN 'text' THEN trim(json_extract(e.canonical_json,'$.text'),char(9,10,11,12,13,28,29,30,31,32,5760,8192,8193,8194,8195,8196,8197,8198,8200,8201,8202,8232,8233,8287,12288))<>'' WHEN 'integer' THEN 1 WHEN 'real' THEN 1 WHEN 'true' THEN 1 WHEN 'false' THEN 1 WHEN 'null' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_runtime_execution_events WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session}) AS saved_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_runtime_execution_actions a JOIN scope r ON r.run_id=a.run_id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND a.kind='TOOL') AS tool_count ) SELECT run_count,run_count+finished_count AS message_count,saved_count+tool_count AS event_count,tool_count FROM totals
